claim: The SMT process instruction (工艺说明-PT9L, F0154, line 16) references the EBOM as 'PT9L-EBOM01 (按照最新版本执行)' without locking a specific version. The EBOM document itself (F0157) is versioned as 'PT9L-EBOM01 V1.0', confirming that versioning exists for the EBOM, yet the process instruction deliberately omits pinning to any version. This floating reference means the process instruction will automatically adopt any future BOM revision without a formal change-control event being triggered against the process instruction itself, violating the requirement that DMR records constitute a frozen, traceable set of manufacturing documents.
reason: Evidence is sufficient to confirm. DMR-021 (F0154 line 16) directly shows the process instruction uses the open-ended phrase '按照最新版本执行' for PT9L-EBOM01, while DMR-032/033/034 (F0157) confirm the EBOM carries an explicit version identifier (V1.0). The coexistence of a versioned EBOM and an unversioned reference in the process instruction is a documented change-control gap: any future revision of PT9L-EBOM01 (e.g., V1.1, V2.0) would silently become the operative BOM for SMT production without requiring a corresponding revision or approval of the process instruction. Under 21 CFR Part 820.70(a) / ISO 13485 §7.5.1, the DMR must specify or reference controlled, identified versions of all production documents; a 'latest version' pointer does not satisfy this requirement.
